pattern_scan_500.root_cause: yfinance history DataFrame contains NaN values in Close/High/Low columns for some stocks (INFY.NS observed). These NaN values propagate through numpy array operations in pattern detection functions (detect_double_top, detect_range etc.). Additionally, yf.Ticker.fast_info.last_price returns NaN for some stocks, and `NaN or 0` in Python evaluates to NaN (not 0) because NaN is truthy. Python's json.dumps raises ValueError for NaN/Inf floats by default.
pattern_scan_500.fix_applied: Added _safe_float() helper to convert NaN/Inf to 0.0, _sanitize_pattern() to sanitize all pattern dict values, df.dropna(subset=['Close','High','Low','Open']) at start of _detect_patterns_for_df to remove NaN rows, and fixed fast_info.last_price to use _safe_float() instead of `or 0`.
pattern_scan_500.reproduction: GET /api/insider/pattern-scan?symbols=INFY returned 500 before fix, 200 after fix.

stray_jsx_text.root_cause: In SensexRejOptionsSection.jsx lines 348-351, the loading spinner div was placed OUTSIDE the {!pick?.is_real_oi && pick && ()} conditional block, and followed by a stray )} character. This caused React to render )} as literal text on the page and the loading spinner to always show (not just when loading=true).
